name: TOUCH PADS / CONTROL PANELS
text:
Infrared sauna contains a bunch of configurable electrical parts. A control panel or a touch pad allows to have one spot to control everything from. It usually comes with a power board as many of the electrical parts are just switched on and off.

Getting a control panel upgrade or a replacement if it is malfunctioning or if it stopped working altogether is possible here.

Remote control over all the functions through one point adds to the relaxation from the sauna experience.

If you’re not sure how to repair your control board, we can help you fix it, just fill in the troubleshooting form.

We’re looking forward to helping you get the most from the sauna.
text_short:
We supply high-quality custom electrical components for infrared sauna, such as control panels, touch pads and circuit boards.
Sauna control panel allows to customize the time, temperature, lights, audio system and chromotherapy settings. This device is easy to operate and has intuitive design. (Just press a button to adjust the settings!)
